title: PAINT WARS
hook: Two teams, one grid. Paint the floor your colour, dash to splash, own the most when the buzzer goes.

theme.keyArtPrompt: A chunky pixel-art tile floor half green and half red, two teams of 8-bit runners splashing colour, CRT arcade, no text

sprites.player: glowing neon disc avatar with a light trail
sprites.tile: dark floor tile that glows in a team colour when painted

timeline.hostLine: FINAL 10! The last tally counts double!

host.intro: Move to paint tiles your team colour. Own the most floor!
host.finale: FINAL 10! The last tally counts double!
host.tutorial: Move to paint. DASH to splash a 3x3 and stun enemies. Most floor every 5 s scores. Behind? Your splash gets bigger.
